ValidationRule.description: Pricing Ticket Link cannot be updated if the Opportunity is Closed
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND ( $Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator', IsClosed = True, ISCHANGED(Pricing_Ticket_Link__c) ) && Opp_Val_Bypass__c = false
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You can not update a Closed Opportunity. If you need a correction made, please submit a ticket in Jira for your Salesforce Administrator and include the link to this Opportunity and the link for the Pricing Ticket.
